svg.title: Jax
svg.desc: Jax, the Liminal HQ otter companion, as a small 3D-style otter holding his crimson book. A dark Afterglow banner: he sways, blinks and wags his tail in a drifting amber glow, while his moods roll by with a caption — reading, flipping a page, a cup of tea, fishing for typos, a party with a hat and confetti, and a nap floating on his back.

g.text: reading the style guide. again. for fun.
just peeking at chapter four, no spoilers
steeping. the pages can wait a minute
something’s biting. probably a stray comma
it worked! your book is ready
floating. wake me if you need me

svg.text: A small 3D otter companion for your app
Calm, spring-smoothed moods. Always optional, never in the way.
